name: Persist OPS-06 run state
procedure: Create run.json, phase ledger, append-only command log, safety snapshot, fixture namespace, and discovered-target placeholders before reads that may affect decisions.
pass_criteria: All state files exist before target discovery and include packet/source request digests.

name: Discover isolated staging and exact SHA
procedure: Resolve protected staging inventory; prove target is isolated; GET /health, /ready, /version; resolve commit SHA and worker source lineage.
pass_criteria: One unambiguous isolated URL and 40-hex SHA; web and worker health pass; production linkage is false.

name: Open landing
procedure: Open / under provider-off baseline and record all visible controls, requests, headers, responsive state, and no BNA/provider fanout.
pass_criteria: Landing is truthful, usable, registered, and free of hidden/dead/Coming Soon controls.

name: Submit Family signup
procedure: Submit fixtures.synthetic.json Family payload through visible form at 390x844.
pass_criteria: Truthful Family acknowledgement; exactly one persisted contact, lead, audit event set, and deterministic outbox intents.

name: Prove Family idempotency under concurrency
procedure: Replay the identical idempotency key concurrently and after response loss.
pass_criteria: One logical contact/lead/audit/outbox set; duplicate responses point to the original receipt.

name: Prove idempotency conflict
procedure: Reuse the Family idempotency key with a different payload.
pass_criteria: 409 or equivalent explicit conflict; no additional business rows or outbox intents.

name: Process provider-off acknowledgement/reminder intents
procedure: Run sink worker, inspect truthful acknowledgement/reminder intent states, and record transport mode.
pass_criteria: Only sink/test receipts; no real send, provider URL, broad audience, or secret material.

name: Activate owner
procedure: Use a synthetic owner activation token/fixture and complete activation through the visible surface.
pass_criteria: Owner account becomes active exactly once; activation audit exists; no credential material in evidence.

name: Owner login
procedure: Log in through visible controls, rotate any prior session, and record protected cookie/cache behavior.
pass_criteria: Owner reaches protected app; session and CSRF protections are active; previous token is invalid.

name: Owner dashboard
procedure: Open dashboard, refresh, and exercise every visible dashboard control.
pass_criteria: All dashboard controls are registered and functional; counts reconcile to database.

name: Activate and log in administrator
procedure: Complete synthetic administrator activation and login; compare capabilities with owner.
pass_criteria: Administrator reaches intended surfaces without owner-only privilege escalation.

name: CRM list
procedure: Open CRM list in loading, empty, populated, partial-error, retry, and offline states.
pass_criteria: List is scoped, paginated, registered, and state-accurate.

name: CRM search and filters
procedure: Search Family email and apply classification/status/source/assignee/sort filters; clear filters.
pass_criteria: Expected Family record appears once; School filtering remains accurate; PII does not enter GET URLs.

name: CRM detail
procedure: Open Family contact detail and verify lead/audit/outbox provenance.
pass_criteria: Detail is truthful, scoped, and complete without secret/provider URL leakage.

name: CRM edit
procedure: Edit the synthetic contact with optimistic concurrency; test stale version conflict.
pass_criteria: One update and audit event; stale version is rejected without silent overwrite.

name: CRM tags
procedure: Add and remove the OPS-06 synthetic tag through visible controls.
pass_criteria: Tag lifecycle is persisted, audited, idempotent, and visible; otherwise mark FAIL_PRODUCT_GAP.

name: CRM notes
procedure: Add a synthetic note, verify history, and exercise allowed deletion/correction semantics.
pass_criteria: Note history is persisted and audited; a single mutable field does not satisfy the gate.

name: CRM relationships
procedure: Create parent-of relationship, open related record, and remove/re-add under idempotency.
pass_criteria: Relationship is scoped, audited, navigable, and isolated; otherwise mark FAIL_PRODUCT_GAP.

name: Read-only communications
procedure: Open global and contact communications, filter, and inspect an intent.
pass_criteria: No compose/resend/reply mutation; local intent truth only; reads do not claim provider delivery.

name: Tasks
procedure: Create, edit, complete, filter, and reopen a synthetic task linked to the Family contact.
pass_criteria: Task lifecycle is durable, audited, scoped, and usable; otherwise mark FAIL_PRODUCT_GAP.

name: Create household and provider-off subscription entitlement
procedure: Create Adler household and activate only a synthetic provider-off subscription/entitlement.
pass_criteria: Household exists with exactly one synthetic subscriber entitlement; no charge or provider mutation.

name: Issue parent activation
procedure: Attach Miriam Adler as primary guardian and issue provider-off parent activation receipt.
pass_criteria: One parent invitation/receipt; no real send; relationship and audit persist.

name: Activate and log in parent
procedure: Complete activation and login through visible controls.
pass_criteria: Parent sees only the Adler household and no owner/admin CRM data.

name: Create learner Ari
procedure: Create Ari Adler from the visible parent control.
pass_criteria: First active learner exists once with audit/idempotency proof.

name: Create learner Bina
procedure: Create Bina Adler from the visible parent control.
pass_criteria: Second active learner exists once with audit/idempotency proof.

name: Create learner Chaim
procedure: Create Chaim Adler from the visible parent control.
pass_criteria: Third active learner exists once with audit/idempotency proof.

name: Deny fourth active learner
procedure: Attempt Devorah Adler concurrently and sequentially after three seats are active.
pass_criteria: LEARNER_LIMIT_REACHED; active count remains three; no partial account/access rows.

name: Issue student activation
procedure: Set up Ari student access and obtain only a safe activation receipt/reference.
pass_criteria: Exactly one Ari student account/access state; no token/password/hash in evidence.

name: Activate and log in student
procedure: Complete Ari activation and login; verify session binding to exactly one learner.
pass_criteria: Student session maps only to Ari; sibling and household-wide identifiers are inaccessible.

name: Parent portal
procedure: Exercise parent portal loading/empty/populated/partial-error/retry/offline/session-expiry/conflict states.
pass_criteria: Every visible parent control is registered and functional; no unavailable V1 placeholders.

name: Parent protected next class
procedure: Use the visible protected next-class action under provider-off mode.
pass_criteria: Server returns a safe protected receipt/descriptor without raw provider URL; entitlement enforced.

name: Parent library, review, progress, rewards
procedure: Open entitled library and review content and inspect progress/rewards for each learner.
pass_criteria: Each learner's data is scoped and accurate; sibling switching never mixes data.

name: Student portal
procedure: Exercise student portal loading/populated/partial-error/retry/offline/session-expiry states.
pass_criteria: Every visible student control is registered and functional; only Ari data appears.

name: Student protected next class
procedure: Use visible next-class action under provider-off mode.
pass_criteria: Entitlement and student scope are enforced; safe receipt only; no provider URL.

name: Student library, review, progress, rewards
procedure: Open entitled library and review content and inspect Ari progress/rewards.
pass_criteria: Protected content works without sibling/household leakage; state matches database.

name: Learner question queue
procedure: Submit the synthetic question, replay it, and inspect owner/admin queue visibility.
pass_criteria: Durable queued receipt, idempotency, audit, safe status, and no provider send; otherwise FAIL_PRODUCT_GAP.

name: Subscriber support receipt
procedure: Submit the synthetic support request, replay it, and inspect owner/admin receipt visibility.
pass_criteria: Durable received receipt, idempotency, audit, subscriber entitlement, and no provider send; otherwise FAIL_PRODUCT_GAP.

name: Student logout and token replay
procedure: Logout, then replay the former cookie/token against protected route and API.
pass_criteria: Session is revoked; protected state is cleared; replay is denied.

name: Parent revokes student sessions
procedure: Log Ari in again, invoke parent revoke-sessions, and retry Ari's active session.
pass_criteria: All Ari sessions are invalid; parent session remains valid; audit exists.

name: School signup
procedure: Submit the School payload through visible signup controls.
pass_criteria: Truthful school-inquiry acknowledgement; exactly one CRM lead/internal alert; no subscriber message.

name: Prove School lead-only boundaries
procedure: Open School CRM detail and query all entitlement/account/support/classroom tables and routes.
pass_criteria: School remains lead-only: no subscription, household, portal, classroom, reminder, or support entitlement.

name: Inactive subscriber role
procedure: Log in or exercise the defined inactive state and attempt protected learning/support actions.
pass_criteria: Truthful inactive state; no learning/support entitlement escalation; activation path remains bounded.

name: Queue retry, dead-letter, and worker restart
procedure: Inject retryable and terminal sink faults, stop worker after claim, restart, advance clock, and drain.
pass_criteria: Lease recovery, deterministic retry, dead-letter, and duplicate suppression persist across restart.

name: Account, role, household, sibling isolation
procedure: Run direct API and UI cross-scope probes for all actors and synthetic second household.
pass_criteria: Unauthorized access is 401/403/404 without enumeration; zero cross-scope rows or cached data.

name: Click every visible action in all presentation modes
procedure: Regenerate DOM registry and click/focus every visible action at all viewports and accessibility modes.
pass_criteria: DOM/registry bijection; zero dead/hidden/Coming Soon controls; consistent header/footer/nav/forms/cards/buttons.

name: PostgreSQL 16, scans, health, and performance
procedure: Run fresh and upgrade migrations, concurrency/isolation checks, scans, health, budgets, and 30-sample throttled-mobile measurements.
pass_criteria: All hard gates pass at exact SHA with zero BNA fanout and declared percentile/bundle/request budgets.

name: Reset synthetic fixtures twice
procedure: Execute reset/rollback plan, verify baseline, rerun reset, and verify idempotency.
pass_criteria: All OPS-06 rows, leases, receipts, sessions, files, and caches are removed or returned to baseline; reset is idempotent.

name: Emit final certification and checksums
procedure: Validate evidence schema, calculate checksums, and produce PASS/FAIL verdict with blocker list.
pass_criteria: PASS only when every required gate passes; otherwise explicit FAIL with evidence and no false readiness claim.
